about: The Comet's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Comet", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is a cocky young jump-pack raider, a bright, nasal, fast tenor on his helmet radio, higher and quicker than the Ranger, lower and brighter than the Prospector; its lines go through comm.py like theirs. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vcomet = reports in, cometdeath = death cry, pistol = both pistols (one volley per shot, every 0.79 s), jetup = the jet pack firing for a cliff jump, jetland = the landing.

entries.text: [fast, cocky, over a helmet radio] Jet pack's primed. Point me at a cliff.
[grinning, clipped] Two pistols, zero brakes. Let's ride.
[quick, reckless] Fueled up and itching to jump. Where to?
[smirking, fast] Raider's up. Their workers won't see me coming.
[sharp cry, cut short] Not like this—!

entries.prompt: twin heavy sci-fi pistols fired almost together, two sharp punchy cracks a split second apart, snappy metallic report, short dry tail, close up
double tap from two futuristic hand cannons, right then left, hard electric snap with a bright metal ring, tight and dry
two loud pistol shots in very quick succession from heavy sci-fi handguns, punchy crack and metallic snap, short tail, close up
jet pack ignition for a leap: a sharp whump of ignition then a short roaring rocket thrust burst that whooshes away
sci-fi jump jets firing: a pop and a hissing blast of hot thrust, rushing whoosh, cut off quickly
rocket backpack kicks on, loud gritty flame roar and airy whoosh lifting off, short and punchy
jet pack landing: a short puff of retro thrust and heavy armoured boots thudding onto dirt, gear rattle
soldier in power armor drops to the ground from a jump, quick thruster hiss dying out, heavy crunching boot impact
hard landing on gravel after a rocket jump, dull heavy thump, metal clank, a last sputter of jet exhaust
